question.text: After SEBI rationalization, how many benchmark index option products with weekly expiry may each exchange offer?

answer.text: One weekly benchmark index option product per exchange (for example, NIFTY weekly on NSE or SENSEX weekly on BSE)
Unlimited weekly products for any underlying
Weekly options are no longer permitted after SEBI rationalization

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI's rationalization measures, effective 20 November 2024, each exchange may offer derivative products with weekly expiry on only one benchmark index. NSE has retained NIFTY and BSE has retained SENSEX as their respective weekly benchmark products. The Trap: Weekly options have not been banned; they are restricted to one benchmark per exchange, so claims of unlimited products or three weekly products per exchange overstate the source. Note: The restriction applies to weekly expiry on benchmark index option products at the exchange level rather than to the broader set of monthly contracts on non-benchmark indices.
